editorial:
Step into the Alabama woods with a group of paranormal YouTubers who think they are chasing ghosts at a haunted attraction the night before Halloween. Instead, you meet Tickles and his caretaker brother Bull, two backwoods killers who turn a fun filming trip into a bloody survival game. The movie mixes found-footage nerves with old-school slasher chases, so you feel the panic as each creator realizes the scares are real. The cast sells the fear well, especially when the group splits up and the woods close in. You get loud jumps, dark humor, and a strong sense that no one is safe once the cameras start rolling.

Standout moments come from the practical gore, fast pacing, and the way the villains feel larger than life without losing their creepy charm. The movie does lean on familiar tropes, and some characters make dumb choices, but the energy rarely drops. If you enjoy chaotic horror with a party vibe, this is a fun ride. Watch it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray if you want the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the last survivors try to escape through the attraction's back tunnels, but Tickles catches them one by one. Bull reveals he has been protecting the property for years and locks the final door behind them. The twist is that the whole fake ghost setup was a trap to lure content creators into the woods. The final shot shows a new video upload from the killers' channel, proving they will keep hunting for views.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves chaotic backwoods slashers and found-footage scares.
